sources.finding: Closing keywords declare which issues a PR closes; automatic closure depends on the default target branch.
Normal exit defaults to zero, requiring an explicit outcome code for no-work and incomplete runs.
onIdle waits for empty queued and pending work; it cannot establish that useful work was performed.
Repository dependency freshness detected this release and required updating all three exact Docker Node pins.

decision: Extend the existing queue, report and completion formatter; a replacement queue cannot fix the missing outcome contract.
